stem: A controlled prescription presents several unresolved diversion red flags. Which pharmacist actions are consistent with exercising federal corresponding responsibility before a dispensing decision? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Treat technical EPCS authentication as separate from the substantive legitimate-medical-purpose determination.
Dispense solely because another pharmacy previously filled a similar prescription
Review the prescription and patient information for a legitimate medical-purpose explanation
Contact the prescriber when appropriate to clarify material red flags
Document material verification information supporting the dispensing decision

explanation.core_reasoning: Corresponding responsibility requires an independent, fact-sensitive effort to resolve material red flags before dispensing.

choice_analysis.A: Technical authenticity does not by itself resolve the pharmacist's corresponding-responsibility inquiry.
choice_analysis.B: Another pharmacy's action does not discharge this pharmacist's duty.
choice_analysis.C: Substantive review is part of the duty.
choice_analysis.D: Verification can help resolve legitimacy concerns.

related_facts: Technical validity and medical-purpose validity are different questions.
explanation.mpje_trap: Letting EPCS authentication or another pharmacy substitute for professional judgment.
